lines.en: Hello. There are two of us.

lines.beaver_en: Please sit here. Here's the menu.

lines.learner: 팔천 원이요? 이거 두 개 주세요.
lines.roman: palcheon woniyo? igeo du gae juseyo.

lines.beaver: 네, 비빔밥 두 개요. 음료도 드릴까요?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, bibimbap du gaeyo. eumnyodo deurilkkayo?

lines.beaver_en: Water is over there. It's self-serve.

lines.beaver: 만두도 있어요. 한 개에 천 원이에요.
lines.beaver_en: We have dumplings too. 1,000 won each.
lines.beaver_roman: mandudo isseoyo. han gaee cheon wonieyo.

lines.beaver: 네, 만두 다섯 개요. 금방 드릴게요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay, five dumplings. Coming right up.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, mandu daseot gaeyo. geumbang deurilgeyo.
lines.en: Excuse me! Where is the bathroom?

lines.beaver_en: Over there. It's the door on the right.

lines.beaver: 다 드셨어요? 모두 이만 천 원이에요.
lines.beaver_en: All done? It's 21,000 won in total.
lines.beaver_roman: da deusyeosseoyo? modu iman cheon wonieyo.
lines.learner: 네, 잘 먹었어요. 카드 여기 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, I enjoyed the meal. Here's my card.
lines.roman: ne, jal meogeosseoyo. kadeu yeogi isseoyo.
